issues.description: OQ-1 RESOLVED-ACCEPTED (adjudicated MAJOR->MINOR): SPT-03 AC1's literal grep `grep -r "bpm\.tenant_id|set_config.*tenant|WHERE tenant_id|tenant_id = \$" src/` is unsatisfiable as written — verified: Class G registry queries against tenant_schemas/tenant_hostnames/tenant_realm_binding in pool.zig, provisioning.zig, tenant_lifecycle.zig, tenant_migration.zig legitimately contain `WHERE tenant_id = $N`, and owner_tenant_id (62) / production_tenant_id (49) bind lines in src/ contain the `tenant_id = $` substring. The design's scoped interpretation (§8.2 R1-R4 + §8.3 allow-list: no bpm.tenant_id/set_config.*tenant; no tenant_id on Class B business tables; Class G allow-list retained) is faithful to the AC's intent, complete, and unambiguous -> ACCEPTED-AS-IS. Formal SPT-03 AC1 requirement-text re-scope queued for REQ-ANALYST (WF-01) as a non-blocking follow-up; BACKEND-DEV may implement against the accepted interpretation.

OQ-2 ACCEPTED: SPT-02 'Tables affected' list is stale vs live schema — verified process_instances does NOT exist (005 creates instance_projections+tokens+tasks), sessions has NO tenant_id (008), tenant_hostnames is a public routing table that KEEPS tenant_id (050). Class B information_schema reconciliation (§4) is the authoritative copy list. Requirement text should be updated by REQ-ANALYST in the same follow-up.

OQ-3 ACCEPTED: 062 and GBL-123 coexist idempotently — GBL-123 (ISS-503-guarded) stays for the test_iss503_rls_removal.zig raw-file test; 062 adds the data-migration pre-flight (data_migrated_at) and explicit composite-index drops. No consolidation required.

OQ-4 ACCEPTED: storage_mode column stays for provisioning.zig (writes SCHEMA, verified) and tenant_migration.zig (reads it, verified); only the pool.zig routing call site is removed. Whether to delete resolveAndCacheStorageMode is deferred to SPT-04 test rework (iss107_tenant_storage_mode_test / tnt_schema_isolation_test re-assert schema-only routing) — the design's conservative answer is correct.

OQ-5 ACCEPTED with implementation constraint: no runner change needed — verified the misclassification guard (src/db/migrations.zig declaresUnqualifiedTableWork) skips %I lines and comments and accepts schema-qualified refs; lint_migration_schema.py BLOCKERs public.<business_table> only in NON-GBL files and does not match `public.%I` (069 precedent). CONSTRAINT: 062/063 per-table DDL must be emitted via EXECUTE format(... %I ...) with `public.%I` in the format string — static `public.<table>` would fail lint_migration_schema.py M001 (BLOCKER), bare `<table>` would fail the runner's MigrationScopeMismatch guard. Design §6.3/§10.1 should state this explicitly for BACKEND-DEV.

Count discrepancy (measurement/state variance, non-gating): design states src tenant_id = 972 refs/66 files, tests/integration = 2369/118. Independent re-measurement on the current tree: src \btenant_id\b = 967/85 (substring 1401/92); tests/integration \btenant_id\b = 1637/91 (substring 2157/102). Magnitudes agree and both far exceed the requirement's 37-file estimate; no design conclusion depends on the exact count. BACKEND-DEV must re-run `grep -rn tenant_id src/` at implementation (design already mandates this).

SPT-04 §9.2 high-impact list omits svc04_admin_api_test.zig, which calls set_config('bpm.tenant_id', $1, false) directly at 4 sites (lines 471/496/607/626) for RLS-based inserts into tenant-scoped tables. Covered by the general 'every' instruction, but should be named for completeness.

Requirement-status machinery drift: tools/reqctl.py VALID_STATUSES omits DESIGNED/DESIGN-REVIEWED/TEST-DESIGNED/TEST-DESIGN-REVIEWED, so `reqctl set-status SPT-02 DESIGN-REVIEWED` exits 1 (verified, no mutation) even though AGENT_SYSTEM.md defines DESIGN-REVIEWED as the CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR PASS status. DOC-UPDATER must apply SPT-02/03/04 -> DESIGN-REVIEWED by direct edit of docs/requirements.yaml + docs/status/requirement_status.yaml, or after the tool is fixed. Exact intended commands recorded in result.next_action/result.summary.
